entries.name: hello-tool
entries.title: Hello tool
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Example signed tool: a command, colour rule, panel and a ROT13 decoder.

entries.name: station-log
entries.title: Station log
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Lists the stations the Station DB tool hears, with /seen and /whois commands.

entries.name: monitor-colouriser
entries.title: Monitor colouriser
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Colours heard traffic by NAMES.GP station type.

entries.name: ctext-macros
entries.title: CTEXT macro pack
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Canned /cq /73 /qth text macros.

entries.name: auto-responder
entries.title: Auto-responder
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Greets an incoming connect (QTEXT/PMS style).

entries.name: beacon-scheduler
entries.title: Beacon scheduler
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: /beacon <min> <comment> — a periodic status beacon, every 10 min or more (TX-gated); /beacon off.

entries.name: packet-decoder
entries.title: Packet decoder
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Paste a raw TNC2 or APRS-IS line and see every field it carries.

entries.name: digimode-decoders
entries.title: PSK31 + CW decoders
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Decode PSK31 varicode + CW (Morse) — the audio-cache decoders.

entries.name: aprs-ssid-guide
entries.title: APRS SSID guide
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: A quick reference of the conventional APRS -SSID assignments.

entries.name: watch-alert
entries.title: Watch & alert
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Highlight + log heard callsigns you /watch (any source); see hits in a panel.

entries.name: mheard
entries.title: MHeard
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Rolling recently-heard stations, aggregated across sources (RF terminal, APRS, …).

entries.name: auto-status
entries.title: Auto-status
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: /autostatus <min> <text> — periodically transmit a status (TX-gated).

entries.name: grid-bearing
entries.title: Grid & bearing
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: /grid <locA> [locB] — distance + bearing between two Maidenhead locators (GP QTH; peers may query).

entries.name: sevenplus
entries.title: 7PLUS reassembler
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Collect multi-part 7plus messages: the file, the parts found and the parts still missing.

entries.name: unit-convert
entries.title: Unit converter
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: /conv <value> <from> <to> — km/mi/m/ft/yd/kn/kmh/nm + c/f.

entries.name: cw-encoder
entries.title: CW encoder
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: /cw <text> — encode text to Morse (dot/dash).

entries.name: station-db
entries.title: Station DB (NAMES.GP)
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Classifies heard stations (NAMES.GP) and shares them on the inter-tool bus.

entries.name: info-responder
entries.title: Info / menu responder
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Answers a peer's INFO / MENU / WHOIS <call> (GP gpserv/gpdir).

entries.name: away-note
entries.title: Away note
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Away-message + let a connected peer leave a short note (not a mailbox).

entries.name: connect-bell
entries.title: Connect bell
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Rings (logs a notice) when a station connects.

entries.name: link-ping
entries.title: Link ping (RTT)
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Rolling round-trip-time to the connected station (GP rtt).

entries.name: sched-query
entries.title: Scheduled query (GPAUTO)
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: /gpauto <steps> — run/schedule a connect/waitfor/send/disconnect batch (GP GPAUTO).

entries.name: block-art
entries.title: Block art (GIP)
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: Render CP437/ANSI block art (GP GIP). /art <text>, or push render.blocks on the bus.

entries.name: map-waypoints
entries.title: Map waypoints
entries.author: OE8APR
entries.description: /wp <locator|lat,lon> [label] — drop a marker on the map; /wpclear to reset.
